name: Chef's Knife
flavor: Still smells like onions and minimum wage.

name: Trauma Shears

name: Framing Hammer
flavor: Twenty-two ounces of opinion.

name: Desk Calculator

name: Coach's Whistle
flavor: Blowing it makes monsters briefly feel like they're running laps.

name: Tattoo Gun
flavor: Battery at 61%. Make every needle count.

name: Ring Light

name: Trick Cane
flavor: Turns into a bouquet of fake flowers. Exactly once.

name: Pipe Wrench
flavor: Eighteen inches of righty-tighty.

name: Laser Pointer
flavor: For making points. Do not point at eyes. Unless they're bad eyes.

name: Bartender's Key
flavor: Opens bottles, cans, and the occasional jugular.

name: Mag Flashlight

name: Dental Pick
flavor: You've seen what this does to plaque. Imagine an eye.

name: Ice Cream Scoop
flavor: Melon-baller energy. Very upsetting in the right hands.

name: Pump Bug Sprayer
flavor: Half full of something that says DANGER in three languages.

name: Gas Station Plunger
flavor: You did not wash it. There was no time.

name: Engraved Cake Knife
flavor: Engraved with a date that no longer matters.

name: IV Pole
flavor: Squeaky wheel included. The bag is empty. Probably.

name: Kettlebell
flavor: Thirty-five pounds. Swing from the hips.

name: Tire Iron
flavor: Lefty-loosey, monster-skully.

name: Karaoke Microphone
flavor: Still has echo turned up to eleven.

name: House Bowling Ball
flavor: Twelve pounds. The finger holes are a little too sticky.

name: Bathrobe
flavor: Terrycloth. Belt optional. Dignity not included.

name: Rented Tuxedo Jacket
flavor: The deposit is gone. Everything is gone.

name: Patent Leather Shoes
flavor: They click. Everyone can hear them click.

name: Hospital Gown
flavor: Open in the back. The dungeon has seen everything.

name: Grip Socks
flavor: Little rubber smiles on the bottom. They grip. They believe in you.

name: Gym Shorts
flavor: Five-inch inseam. Bold.

name: Terry Sweatband
flavor: Keeps the sweat out of your eyes. The blood is your problem.

name: Stained Hoodie
flavor: The stain is shaped like Ohio. Nobody knows what it is.

name: Sequin Blazer
flavor: Catches the light. Catches every light. Catches the eye of every predator.

name: Paper Dental Bib
flavor: Clipped on with a little chain. Absorbs approximately one drool.

name: Giant Hot Dog Costume
flavor: Foam bun. Surprisingly protective. Monsters will think you're food.

name: Swim Trunks
flavor: Pineapple pattern. Drawstring permanently knotted.

name: Flip-Flops
flavor: The worst possible shoes for the end of the world.

name: Rental Bowling Shoes
flavor: Size 10 1/2. Sprayed with something. Two-tone.

name: Bowling Shirt
flavor: Embroidered name tag says 'Ricky'. You are not Ricky.

name: Mail Satchel
flavor: Neither rain nor sleet nor the screaming thing in the hall.

name: Handheld Stop Sign
flavor: It has always worked before. Cars respect it. Monsters might.

name: Electric Grooming Clippers
flavor: Cordless. Rated for poodles. Not rated for this.

name: Red Grading Pen
flavor: You've failed tougher customers than this.

name: Car Keys on a Lanyard
flavor: The car is gone. The keys remain. Click the button. Hear nothing.

name: Take-a-Number Dispenser
flavor: Now serving: you. Now serving: pain.

name: Fry Basket
flavor: Still dripping. Still hot. Still has some fries in it.

name: Espresso Tamper
flavor: Thirty pounds of pressure, evenly applied.

name: Due Date Stamp
flavor: Stamps OVERDUE in red. The monster is very overdue.

name: Hi-Vis Safety Vest
flavor: You are very visible. That is a mixed blessing down here.

name: Industrial Serving Ladle
flavor: One scoop of violence. No seconds.

name: Campaign Hat
flavor: Wide brim. Strap under the chin. Authority over squirrels.

name: Moisture Probe
flavor: Detects rot. In wood, walls, and walls that are actually monsters.

name: Lockpick Roll
flavor: Twelve picks, two tension wrenches, and an attitude.

name: Meat Cleaver
flavor: It knows what it's for.

name: Wire Strippers
flavor: Insulated handles. That's the important part.

name: Hedge Trimmers
flavor: Long-reach. Carbon steel. Has seen some hedges.

name: Clipboard
flavor: Holds forms. Blocks blows. Is, in a legal sense, a shield.

name: Open House Sign
flavor: Arrow points left. Your face is on it. Smiling.

name: Pill Counting Tray
flavor: Counts by fives. Counts fast. Counts on you.

name: Animal Control Pole
flavor: Loop goes around the neck. Works on dogs. Works on worse.

name: Call Center Headset
flavor: Hello, have you considered your extended warranty against death?

name: Trash Grabber
flavor: Pinches things at arm's length. You have been waiting your whole life for this.

name: Can of Refrigerant
flavor: Sprays cold. Very cold. The label has a skull and also a snowflake.

name: Push Broom
flavor: Eighteen inches of bristle. You have pushed worse than this down a hallway.

name: Golf Driver
flavor: Titanium head. Graphite shaft. Forty-dollar grip.

name: Collapsible Baton
flavor: Snaps out with a satisfying click.

name: Portable Defibrillator
flavor: CLEAR. The AI voice says stand back. You do not stand back.

name: Rolled-Up Eye Chart
flavor: E. F P. T O Z. Hit them with the big E.

name: Fog Machine Remote
flavor: One button. Unleashes a fog bank. Now it's a party.

name: Length of Tow Chain
flavor: Hooks on the end. Can drag things that should not be dragged.

name: Embalming Trocar
flavor: Pointy, hollow, and you know exactly where to put it.

name: Floral Shears
flavor: Snips stems. Snips other things.

name: Knee Kicker
flavor: You kick it with your knee. It kicks back with teeth.

name: Aviator Goggles
flavor: Bug-spattered and unbreakable.

name: Stack of Laminated Menus
flavor: Two-sided, wipe-clean, and harder than they look.

name: Inflatable Tube Man
flavor: Deflated. You keep it anyway. It still waves when you blow into it.

name: Tailor's Shears
flavor: Nobody touches the fabric scissors. Nobody.

name: Tuning Hammer
flavor: You can hear when something is sharp. Or flat. Or behind you.

name: Government Tablet
flavor: You were counting people. Now you're counting monsters.

name: Bingo Ball Cage
flavor: Rattles with seventy-five balls. B-9. You sank my B-9.

name: Rescue Tube
flavor: Red foam. Rope included. Saves lives, sometimes yours.

name: Hockey Rink Scraper
flavor: Long and flat. Scrapes ice. Scrapes faces.

name: Hole Punch
flavor: Three-ring. Heavy duty. You punch holes for a living.

name: Saliva Ejector
flavor: It sucks. Literally. Can pull a small weapon out of a hand.

name: Reserve Parachute
flavor: Never deployed. Might deploy. Don't pull the tab indoors.

name: Coil of Coaxial Cable
flavor: Fifty feet of RG6. You can whip with it, or trip things.

name: Bottle of Massage Oil
flavor: Eucalyptus. Slippery. Makes you hard to hold.

name: Waiter's Corkscrew
flavor: You can uncork a bottle in four seconds and an eye in two.

name: Rolled Yoga Mat
flavor: Purple, non-slip, rolled tight. Namaste.

name: Steam Iron
flavor: Linen setting. Hot enough to matter.

name: Branded Stress Ball
flavor: Shaped like a bull. Squeeze it when the market crashes. Market crashed.

name: Roll of Quarters
flavor: Ten dollars of quarters, tight in a fist.

name: Marshalling Wands
flavor: Glow orange. Point where you want things to go. Sometimes they go.

name: Oil Filter Wrench
flavor: Your fingernails will never be clean again. That's fine.

name: Stainless Tongs
flavor: Click click. You grab things. It's what you do.

name: Balloon Pump
flavor: You can make a giraffe in nine seconds. A decoy in twelve.

name: Skinning Knife
flavor: You know where everything comes apart.

name: Card Shoe
flavor: Eight decks. The house always wins. Are you the house now?

name: Studio Mic on a Boom Arm
flavor: You're listening to the end of the world. Lines are open.

name: Presentation Clicker
flavor: Click. Seventy percent chance of death. Click.

name: Roll of Gaffer Tape
flavor: Fixes anything. Anything.

name: Stenotype Machine
flavor: You type 225 words a minute. You will record every scream.

name: Price Tag Gun
flavor: Ka-chunk. Everything has a price.

name: Boat Hook
flavor: Pulls things toward you. Pushes things away. Choose carefully.

name: Chimney Brush
flavor: Wire bristles. Soot permanent. Very 1890s.

name: Bee Smoker
flavor: Puffs of smoke make bees calm. Unclear what they do to everything else.

name: Shepherd's Crook
flavor: Hooks around a neck. Any neck.

name: Spinning Arrow Sign
flavor: MATTRESS SALE. You can spin it at ninety RPM.

name: Umpire Chest Protector
flavor: Took foul balls for a living. Now takes worse.

name: Scalpel
flavor: Very sharp. Very precise. Very expensive malpractice insurance.

name: Metal Nail File
flavor: Pointy on the end. You've buffed tougher.

name: Leather Work Gloves
flavor: Thick enough for anything you'd find in a dumpster. Or a dungeon.

name: Hardcover Hymnal
flavor: Four hundred hymns. Heavy enough for a fifth.

name: Glassblowing Blowpipe
flavor: Five feet of steel tube. One end is still hot.

name: Pool Skimmer
flavor: Extends to sixteen feet. Scoops leaves. Scoops eyes.

name: U-Lock
flavor: Heavy, hardened steel. You've used it on worse than a bike thief.

name: Welding Helmet
flavor: Auto-darkening. Makes you look like a robot knight.

name: Tour Group Flag
flavor: Bright yellow. Everyone follows the flag. Follow the flag.

name: Spray Tan Gun
flavor: Golden Glow #4. Gets in eyes. Gets everywhere.

name: Handcuffs
flavor: You can't arrest anyone. They don't need to know that.

name: Dive Knife
flavor: Strapped to the calf. Serrated on one edge.

name: Transit Authority Badge
flavor: You've seen everything on the 14 bus. This is nothing.

name: Orthopedic Mallet
flavor: You know exactly where to hit a foot. Everything down here has feet.

name: Claw Hammer
flavor: Hits nails. Pulls nails. Covers the basics.

name: Sock Puppet
flavor: His name is Gerald. He says what you can't.

name: Gavel
flavor: ORDER. ORDER.

name: Jeweler's Loupe
flavor: You can tell fake gold from across a room.

name: Ice Chisel
flavor: Wide, flat, very cold. Swans are your specialty.

name: Ride Safety Key
flavor: Keep your hands and arms inside the dungeon at all times.

name: Mining Headlamp
flavor: Lights the way. Lights you up. Lights everything.

name: Horseshoe
flavor: Lucky. Hard. Bent in a way that suggests it's been used for this before.

name: Forge Tongs
flavor: Real fire, fake accent.

name: Steel Film Reel
flavor: Two hours of 35mm. Sails like a discus.

name: Crab Pot Hook
flavor: Rusty, heavy, and still wet.

name: Meter Reading Gun
flavor: Bleeps. Counts. Detects electricity, and things that run on it.

name: Free Sample Perfume
flavor: Excuse me, sir, ma'am, monster. Can I ask you a question?

name: Telescoping Pointer
flavor: Extends to three feet. Points at Orion. Points at eyes.

name: Insulated Pizza Bag
flavor: Keeps things hot. Keeps you warm. Smells like pepperoni forever.

name: Hot Dog Roller Rod
flavor: Pried loose from the machine. Still rotating, a little.

name: Seltzer Bottle
flavor: Sprays in the face. Gets laughs. Gets eyes.

name: Accordion File
flavor: Stuffed with motions. Surprisingly solid.

name: Glass Coffee Pot
flavor: Topped off. Always topped off. Hot enough to matter.

name: Felling Axe
flavor: You've cut down things bigger than whatever that is.

name: Oyster Knife
flavor: Short, stubby, and goes exactly where it needs to.

name: Gas Leak Detector
flavor: Beeps louder near danger. Never stops beeping down here.

name: Chafing Dish Lid
flavor: Stainless. Dented already. Keeps things warm and teeth away.

name: Fitness Headset Mic
flavor: ONE MORE HILL. Monsters hate this one weird trick.

name: Stack of Casino Chips
flavor: Clay, heavy, and nobody can tell you they aren't currency.

name: Long-Handled Squeegee
flavor: You hang off buildings for a living. Heights are a lifestyle.

name: Stack of Glossy Brochures
flavor: ESCAPE TO PARADISE. Ironic.

name: Wrist Pin Cushion
flavor: Forty pins, wrist-mounted. Every punch is a little worse.

name: Pole Saw
flavor: Ten feet of reach. Cuts limbs, the tree kind, usually.

name: Rubber Mallet
flavor: Doesn't crack tile. Does make things see stars.

name: Bundle of Singles
flavor: Fifty ones in a paper strap. Bribes start small.

name: Velvet Rope on a Stanchion
flavor: PLEASE DO NOT TOUCH THE EXHIBITS. The exhibits touched first.

name: CB Radio Handset
flavor: Breaker one-nine. Anybody out there? Something answers.

name: Sledgehammer
flavor: Ten pounds. Breaks rock. Breaks rocks that move.

name: Bowling Pin
flavor: Maple wood. Ten of them stood up for you every day.

name: Crystal Ball
flavor: You saw this coming. You did not see this coming.

name: Jab Saw
flavor: Cuts holes in walls. Some walls bleed now.

name: Studio Headphones
flavor: Closed-back. You can hear a mouse cough at forty yards.

name: Surveying Tripod
flavor: Three legs. Brass fittings. Everything down here is out of level.

name: Spot Remover Spray
flavor: Removes stains. Removes pigment. Removes vision.

name: Glass Suction Lifter
flavor: Grips anything flat. Pulls anything loose.

name: Healing Crystal
flavor: Rose quartz. Does it work? Here, for the first time, maybe.

name: Cosmetic Laser Wand
flavor: Class IV. Do not look into the business end.

name: Ring of Casino Keys
flavor: Opens slot machines. Opens a surprising number of chests.

name: Aquarium Net
flavor: Sized for goldfish. Optimistic.

name: Box Cutter
flavor: Thumb-slide. Retractable. Opens anything that comes in a box.

name: Ring Toss Rings
flavor: Step right up. Everyone's a winner. Nobody is a winner.

name: Air Horn
flavor: BWAAAAAAAMP. Used sparingly. Used constantly.

name: Cobbler's Hammer
flavor: Small head. Lots of practice.

name: Ripped-Out Taxi Meter
flavor: Still running. Fare is up to $412.

name: Bucket of Chlorine Tablets
flavor: Pool-grade. Do not eat. Do not breathe near.

name: Magnetic Pickup Wand
flavor: Pulls metal out of trash. Pulls loot out of corners.

name: Hard Hat
flavor: OSHA approved. Dented in three places already.

name: Weighted Jump Rope
flavor: Two-pound handles. Double-unders are a war crime.

name: Collection Plate
flavor: Brass. Holds tithes. Holds the line.

name: Sack of Quarters
flavor: Forty dollars in quarters, knotted in a pillowcase.

name: Bite Sleeve
flavor: Jute and leather. Built for German shepherds. Rated for worse.

name: Rolled Gym Towel
flavor: Wet. Rolled tight. Snaps like a whip.

name: Ski Pole
flavor: Carbide tip. Snapped one off a skier who didn't need it anymore.

name: Grave Digger's Spade
flavor: Square-nosed. You've dug a few. You're not scared of the dead.

name: Gas Leaf Blower
flavor: Two-stroke engine. Blows leaves, blows smaller enemies across rooms.

name: Chamois Cloth
flavor: Absorbs water. Absorbs blows, sort of. Very soft.

name: Memory Foam Pillow
flavor: You have to feel it. Feel it. FEEL IT.

name: Diaper Bag
flavor: Has everything. Wipes. Snacks. A tiny emergency.

name: DSLR with Flash
flavor: Smile! The flash is blinding. On purpose.

name: Fountain Pen
flavor: Gold nib. The pen is mightier. Test this.

name: Brass Antique Lamp
flavor: Victorian. Mostly. Rub it. Nothing.

name: Septic Hose Nozzle
flavor: You know what's been through this. You do not care anymore.

name: Coconut Shell Halves
flavor: Clip-clop. Monsters think a horse is coming. A horse is not coming.

name: Cheese Wire
flavor: Two handles, one wire. Cuts a wheel of parm, cuts a throat.

name: Auction Paddle
flavor: Do I hear five? Five? I got five, now six, six, now seven.

name: Brass Knuckles
flavor: Technically illegal in your state. Technically there's no state anymore.

name: Bag of Golf Balls
flavor: Titleist Pro V1. Forty dollars a dozen. Fore.

name: Roman Candle
flavor: Eight shots. Point away from face. Point at face.

name: Metal Detector Wand
flavor: Beeps near metal. Beeps near traps. Beeps near your heart.

name: Water Test Kit
flavor: Tells you the pH of things. Some of these things are acidic.

name: Bottle of India Ink
flavor: Black and permanent. Ruins clothes. Ruins eyes.

name: Plastic Recorder
flavor: Hot Cross Buns. Over and over. It makes things angry.

name: Red Card
flavor: You're out of the game. Get out of the game.

name: Racing Helmet
flavor: Full-face. Fire-rated. You've hit walls at eighty in this.

name: Six-Inch Stiletto
flavor: You can run in these. You can kill in these.

name: Vending Machine Key
flavor: Opens every vending machine. They have them down here, somehow.

name: Ratchet Wrench
flavor: This is the bolt that holds the Zipper together. Was.

name: Tarot Deck
flavor: You drew the Tower. Of course you drew the Tower.

name: Bullhorn
flavor: LADIES AND GENTLEMEN. And whatever that is.

name: Lariat
flavor: Thirty-five feet of nylon. You've roped worse than this.

name: Hand Truck
flavor: Two wheels, one purpose. You can lift a piano. You can lift a monster.

name: Empty Morphine Pump
flavor: You sat with people at the end. This is just more of that.

name: Yanagiba Knife
flavor: Single-bevel. Takes a year to learn to sharpen.

name: Foam Kickboard
flavor: Light, floaty, and better than nothing.

name: Scooter Battery Pack
flavor: Lithium-ion. Do not puncture. Puncture.

name: 25-Foot Tape Measure
flavor: The blade snaps back hard. Measures twice, hits once.

name: Radio Earpiece
flavor: Everyone report to the ballroom. Everyone is dead. Report anyway.

name: Duck Call
flavor: Quack. Something heard you. Something is coming.

name: Mechanical Keyboard
flavor: Cherry MX Blues. Clicky enough to start a fight.

name: Stack of Hotel Key Cards
flavor: Most are demagnetized. One might open something.

name: Deli Slicer Blade
flavor: Twelve-inch disc. You weren't supposed to take it out of the slicer.

name: Heavy-Duty Stapler
flavor: Swingline. Red. Someone wanted this back.

name: Fire Axe From a Glass Case
flavor: IN CASE OF EMERGENCY. This qualifies.

name: Golf Umbrella
flavor: Opens with a whoomp. Blocks a surprising amount.

name: Shopping Cart Handle
flavor: Wrenched off a cart with a bad wheel. It always had a bad wheel.

name: Pool Cue
flavor: Chalked. Warped. Still good for a break.

name: Set of Bar Darts
flavor: Three darts with American flag flights.

name: Pitchfork
flavor: Three tines. Hay still stuck on.

name: Marble Rolling Pin
flavor: Cold. Heavy. Perfect for pie crust and crushing.

name: Cast Iron Skillet
flavor: Seasoned for thirty years. Never washed with soap. Never will be.

name: Garden Hoe
flavor: Rusty edge. Good for weeds. Good for worse.

name: String Trimmer
flavor: Gas-powered. Spins at 10,000 RPM. Line nearly out.

name: Snow Shovel
flavor: Wide plastic blade. Doubles as a shield.

name: Aluminum Baseball Bat
flavor: Little League. Dented from the last game.

name: Hockey Stick
flavor: Taped blade. Taped handle. Taped together.

name: Lacrosse Stick
flavor: Scoops rocks. Flings rocks. Hard.

name: Tennis Racket
flavor: Restrung last week. Can return a thrown object.

name: Putter
flavor: Belly putter. Illegal on the tour. The tour is over.

name: Novelty Nunchucks
flavor: From a mall kiosk. Foam padding, mostly torn off.

name: Mall Katana
flavor: Stainless steel. Decorative. Will break exactly when it matters.

name: Brass Letter Opener
flavor: Monogrammed. Very fancy. Very pointy.

name: Crowbar
flavor: Opens crates. Opens doors. Opens heads.

name: Fireplace Poker
flavor: Black iron. One end glowing faintly, somehow.

name: Mic Stand
flavor: Chrome. Heavy base. Rockstar move.

name: Acoustic Guitar
flavor: Still in tune. Not for long.

name: Bowling Trophy
flavor: Third place, 2011 Mixed League. Little gold man on top is pointy.

name: Bar Stool
flavor: Chrome legs. Vinyl seat. Bar fight classic.

name: Folding Chair
flavor: The wrestler's weapon. Unfolds into a small shield.

name: Empty Fire Extinguisher
flavor: Discharged. Still dense.

name: Travel Iron
flavor: Hot. On the cotton setting.

name: Hair Dryer on a Long Cord
flavor: Swing it by the cord. Like a mace.

name: Curling Iron
flavor: Still plugged into nothing. Still hot.

name: Electric Hand Mixer
flavor: The beaters spin. Who's powering it?

name: Meat Tenderizer
flavor: Spiked aluminum head. Makes everything tender.

name: Rabbit Corkscrew
flavor: Lever-action. Built for corks. Twists into anything.

name: Coat Rack
flavor: Bentwood. Hooks on top. Medieval mace energy.

name: Canoe Paddle
flavor: Wooden. Flat. Traditional spanking dimensions.

name: Bowling Pin
flavor: Maple. Scuffed. A tenpin's revenge.

name: Treadmill Safety Key
flavor: Magnetic. Clipped to your shirt. If you fall, everything stops.

name: Metal Yardstick
flavor: Thirty-six inches of discipline.

name: Toilet Tank Lid
flavor: Porcelain. Heavy. Classic.

name: Garden Gnome
flavor: Smiling. Concrete. Pointed hat.

name: Pink Lawn Flamingo
flavor: Two metal legs. Two metal stabs.

name: Tiki Torch
flavor: Citronella. Lit. Repels mosquitoes and monsters, equally poorly.

name: Altar Candlestick
flavor: Brass. Heavy. Very Clue.

name: Broom
flavor: Corn bristles. Witch adjacent.

name: Wet Mop
flavor: Dripping. Leaves a slippery floor behind.

name: Industrial Plunger
flavor: Flange-head. Grips anything.

name: BBQ Tongs
flavor: Still hot from the grill. Flip things.

name: Grill Spatula
flavor: Serrated edge. Flips burgers. Flips more.

name: Metal Kebab Skewers
flavor: Fourteen inches each. Sharp. Greasy.

name: Bocce Ball
flavor: Resin. Heavy. Rolls true.

name: Pitching Horseshoe
flavor: Steel. Two and a half pounds.

name: Croquet Mallet
flavor: Striped. Wooden. A garden party's last stand.

name: Cricket Bat
flavor: Willow. Flat face. Very British.

name: Ping Pong Paddle
flavor: Sandpaper face. Spin on everything.

name: Skateboard
flavor: Kicktail chipped. Grip tape worn. Ride or swing.

name: Single Roller Skate
flavor: One skate, swung by the laces.

name: Pool Noodle
flavor: Foam. Purple. Absolutely useless as a weapon. Absolutely delightful.

name: Fishing Rod
flavor: Hook still on the line. Snag things from across the room.

name: Speargun
flavor: One spear. Reload takes a while.

name: Traffic Cone
flavor: Orange. Reflective stripe. Weighted base.

name: Stop Sign on a Pole
flavor: Ripped out of concrete. Still has concrete on it.

name: Bike Chain
flavor: Greasy. Swings in a nasty arc.

name: Car Antenna
flavor: Snapped off. Whips like a switch.

name: Jumper Cables
flavor: Red to positive. Black to the monster.

name: Donut Spare Tire
flavor: Never meant for highway speeds or combat.

name: Chrome Hubcap
flavor: A small shield. Very shiny.

name: Mailbox on a Post
flavor: Pulled out of the ground. Mail still in it.

name: Lawn Dart
flavor: Banned in 1988 for a reason. That reason is now useful.

name: Safety Scissors
flavor: Rounded tips. Kindergarten grade. Optimistic.

name: Hot Glue Gun
flavor: Strings everywhere. Burns a little.

name: Staple Gun
flavor: Fires half-inch staples. Not far. Not accurate.

name: Cordless Nail Gun
flavor: Safety tip disabled. Don't ask.

name: Paint Roller on an Extension Pole
flavor: Still wet. Eggshell white.

name: TV Remote
flavor: Batteries in. Points at monsters. Nothing changes.

name: Laptop, Closed
flavor: Battery at 3%. You have unsaved work.

name: Sixteen-Pound Bowling Ball
flavor: The heaviest one in the rack. Customized. Name on it: VERN.

name: Dumbbell
flavor: Twenty pounds. Hexagonal so it won't roll away.

name: Olympic Barbell
flavor: Forty-five pounds. Knurled grip. Nobody re-racked it.

name: Medicine Ball
flavor: Leather. Fourteen pounds. Thump.

name: Speed Rope
flavor: Cable core. Leaves welts.

name: Foam Roller
flavor: Bumpy. Hurts so good. Mostly just hurts.

name: Resistance Band
flavor: Heavy tension. Snaps hard.

name: Microscope

name: Desk Globe
flavor: Shows the world as it was. Which is to say: wrong.

name: Fire Alarm Pull Handle
flavor: Pulled. Ringing somewhere far away.

name: Cash Register Drawer

name: Mannequin Arm
flavor: Fiberglass. The hand is waving. It's always waving.

name: Crash Cymbal
flavor: Bronze. Excellent shield. Terrible noise.

name: Tambourine
flavor: Jingle. Jingle. Jingle.

name: Pair of Drumsticks
flavor: Hickory. 5B. Two-hit combo.

name: Bingo Dauber
flavor: Magenta. Dabs in eyes. Bingo.

name: Toy Laser Sword
flavor: Plastic. Lights up. Makes the noise. Nothing more.

name: Plastic Devil Pitchfork
flavor: From a costume. Bends on contact.

name: Foam LARP Sword
flavor: Handmade. Latex-coated. Its name is Dawnbringer.

name: Selfie Stick
flavor: Extends to forty inches. Phone holder still attached. Phone gone.

name: Squirt Bottle
flavor: For training cats. Works on more than cats.

name: Wrinkled Business Suit
flavor: Charcoal. Off the rack. You had a meeting.

name: Pencil Skirt
flavor: You can take steps about four inches long.

name: Pleated Khakis
flavor: Business casual. The dungeon is not business casual.

name: Company Polo
flavor: Embroidered logo of a company that no longer exists.

name: Lanyard and ID Badge
flavor: Your face looks terrible in the photo. It always will.

name: Adult Footie Pajamas
flavor: Fleece, full-body, with a butt flap. Very warm.

name: Fuzzy Slippers
flavor: Shaped like bunnies. The bunnies are judging you.

name: Silk Kimono Robe
flavor: Embroidered cranes. You felt powerful in it.

name: Bath Towel
flavor: Wrapped around the waist. Tucked tight. Hope.

name: Shower Cap
flavor: Clear plastic. Elastic edge. Keeps things out of your hair.

name: Shower Shoes
flavor: Foam. Squeaky. Saved you from fungus once.

name: Scrubs Top
flavor: Ceil blue. A little bit of someone else's blood.

name: Scrubs Pants
flavor: Drawstring. Many pockets. All empty.

name: Clogs With Charms
flavor: Covered in little pins. A taco, a dog, a skull.

name: Choir Robe
flavor: Maroon, satin trim. You were mid-hymn.

name: Wedding Dress
flavor: Train long enough to trip a monster. Or you.

name: Wedding Veil
flavor: Lace. Cathedral length. Gets caught on everything.

name: Bridesmaid Dress
flavor: Seafoam taffeta. The bride said you could wear it again. You won't.

name: Cummerbund
flavor: Pleats facing up, so you can catch crumbs. True.

name: Grease-Stained Apron
flavor: Kiss the Cook. Nobody will.

name: Hairnet
flavor: Required by health code. The health code is dead.

name: Chef's Jacket
flavor: Double-breasted so you can flip it when one side gets dirty.

name: Non-Slip Kitchen Shoes
flavor: Grip anything. Grease. Blood. Ichor.

name: Cargo Shorts
flavor: Eight pockets. Each one contains a receipt.

name: Fanny Pack
flavor: Worn crossbody. It's fashion now. It was always fashion.

name: Socks and Sandals
flavor: White tube socks. Brown leather sandals. Absolute confidence.

name: Hawaiian Shirt
flavor: Parrots. Hibiscus. Unbuttoned to the sternum.

name: Sun Visor
flavor: Says MYRTLE BEACH. Keeps the glare off.

name: Bucket Hat
flavor: Fishing lures stuck in the band.

name: Sports Jersey
flavor: A star player's number. He's dead now, probably.

name: Foam Finger
flavor: WE'RE #1. You are not.

name: Team Face Paint
flavor: Half blue, half orange. Sweat-streaked.

name: Letterman Jacket
flavor: Varsity, class of 2009. Still fits. Mostly.

name: Ugly Christmas Sweater
flavor: Light-up reindeer. Batteries at 30%.

name: Santa Suit
flavor: Red velvet, fake belly, real beard sweat.

name: Elf Hat
flavor: Jingle bell on the end. Cannot be silenced.

name: Plastic Pirate Hat
flavor: From a birthday party. Not yours.

name: Witch Hat
flavor: Pointy. Felt. Sold as Sexy Witch.

name: Cat Ears Headband
flavor: Glittery. Your actual ears are elsewhere.

name: Costume Cape
flavor: Red satin. Velcro at the neck. You were going to fly someday.

name: Gorilla Suit
flavor: Full-body. Rubber hands. Very hot inside.

name: Inflatable T-Rex Costume
flavor: Fan-powered. The fan is still running. How?

name: Banana Costume
flavor: Bright yellow. Very visible. Monsters will think you're a snack.

name: Tuxedo T-Shirt
flavor: Says you want to be formal but you're here to party.

name: Gray Sweatpants
flavor: The softest thing left in the world.

name: Flannel Shirt
flavor: Red check. Sleeves rolled. Smells like a campfire.

name: Steel-Toe Boots
flavor: Kicks are now weapons.

name: Denim Overalls
flavor: One strap undone, for flair.

name: Mechanic Coveralls
flavor: Name patch says DOUG. You are Doug now.

name: Leather Jacket
flavor: Broken in. Broke someone else in.

name: Biker Vest
flavor: Patches from a club you were technically in.

name: Yoga Pants
flavor: Four-way stretch. Squat-proof.

name: Sports Bra
flavor: High impact. Not this high.

name: Running Shoes
flavor: Carbon plate. Very fast. Very expensive.

name: Padded Cycling Shorts
flavor: Chamois-padded. Leave little to the imagination.

name: Clip-In Cycling Shoes
flavor: Click click click on stone floors. Everyone hears.

name: Bike Helmet
flavor: Foam and plastic. Rated for one crash. You've had two.

name: Wetsuit
flavor: Neoprene, 5mm. You were in the hotel pool.

name: Snorkel Mask
flavor: Fogs up immediately. Breathe through your mouth.

name: Bikini
flavor: Not a lot of armor, frankly.

name: Speedo
flavor: Bold. Aerodynamic. Unprotected.

name: Inflatable Arm Floaties
flavor: Duck-patterned. Proven to work.

name: Swim Cap
flavor: Rubber. Floral. Pinches.

name: Plaid Pajama Pants
flavor: Elastic waist. Flannel. Warm.

name: Vintage Band T-Shirt
flavor: A band nobody's heard of. You'll tell them about it.

name: Novelty Graphic Tee
flavor: I'M WITH STUPID, with an arrow pointing at nothing now.

name: High-Waisted Jeans
flavor: Ironic in 2016. Sincere now.

name: Skinny Jeans
flavor: You can't bend your knees.

name: Fleece Vest
flavor: Company logo of a startup. The finance bro uniform.

name: Navy Blazer
flavor: Gold buttons. You were at a gala, or a funeral.

name: Loafers
flavor: No socks. Bold.

name: High Heels
flavor: Four-inch heels. Running is an option, technically.

name: Clip-On Tie
flavor: Can't be used to strangle you. Thank God.

name: Silk Necktie
flavor: Windsor knot. Something could grab it.

name: Reading Glasses
flavor: +2.00 from the drugstore.

name: Wraparound Sunglasses
flavor: Oakleys. You look like a cop.

name: Trucker Hat
flavor: Mesh back. Says I'D RATHER BE FISHING. You would.

name: Knit Beanie
flavor: Hand-knit by someone who loved you.

name: Cowboy Hat
flavor: Straw. Wide brim. Whole attitude.

name: Cowboy Boots
flavor: Pointed toe. Real leather. Loud on stone.

name: Hospital Wristband
flavor: Your name, birth date, and NPO. Nothing by mouth.

name: Neck Brace
flavor: Foam collar. You can't turn your head. Neither can anything else see you do it.

name: Arm Sling
flavor: Your arm is fine. You just never took it off.

name: Eye Patch
flavor: From a pirate party. You have both eyes.

name: Graduation Gown
flavor: Black polyester. Tassel on the left. You'd just graduated.

name: Graduation Cap
flavor: Can be thrown. Traditionally. Painfully.

name: Sequined Prom Dress
flavor: Catches the light like a disco ball.

name: Wrist Corsage
flavor: Wilting. Smells sweet.

name: Mascot Head
flavor: A giant smiling bird. Mesh eye holes. Can't see anything.

name: Mascot Body Suit
flavor: Feathers. Big feet. You were mid-dance.

name: Kilt
flavor: Traditional. Fully traditional. Fully.

name: Lederhosen
flavor: Suspenders, embroidered. You were at Oktoberfest.

name: Dirndl
flavor: Bow on the left. You weren't sure what that meant.

name: Stick-On Mustache
flavor: Handlebar. Peeling at one corner.

name: Bedsheet Toga
flavor: Twin-size. Fitted. Somehow worked.

name: Plastic Laurel Crown
flavor: Gold spray paint flaking.

name: Velour Tracksuit
flavor: Embroidered on the butt. Juicy.

name: Track Pants
flavor: Snap-away sides. One snap left.

name: Rhinestone Headband
flavor: Pins the hair back. Pins a look in place.

name: Safety Hard Hat
flavor: Orange. Rated to OSHA standards. OSHA is gone.

name: Safety Goggles
flavor: Anti-fog. Scratched to blindness on one side.

name: Reflective Vest
flavor: Neon yellow. Glows in the light.

name: Fuzzy Earmuffs
flavor: Pink. Muffles everything. Everything.

name: Puffy Parka
flavor: Down-filled. You were going skiing.

name: Moon Boots
flavor: Silver. Huge. Squeak on every step.

name: Ski Goggles
flavor: Mirrored. You look like a bug.

name: Mittens
flavor: No thumbs. Well, one thumb.

name: Satin Sleep Mask
flavor: Pushed up on the forehead. Embroidered 'go away'.

name: Hair Curlers
flavor: Pink foam. Twelve of them.

name: Sheet Face Mask
flavor: Cucumber extract. Makes you look like a serial killer.

name: Compression Socks
flavor: Knee-high. Medical grade. Your calves have never felt better.

name: Big Church Hat
flavor: Wide, purple, with a feather. Respect it.

name: Sunday Dress
flavor: Floral. Pressed. Modest.

name: Wingtip Shoes
flavor: Polished to a mirror. Click on tile.

name: Flannel Nightgown
flavor: Grandma-style. Ankle-length.

name: Boxer Shorts
flavor: Hearts pattern. Just the boxers.

name: Briefs
flavor: Classic white. Less white than they were.

name: Garden Clogs
flavor: Rubber. Muddy. Easy to slip on.

name: Gardening Gloves
flavor: Floral. Thorn-proof. Mostly.

name: Straw Sunhat
flavor: Huge brim. Ribbon tie.

name: Bolo Tie
flavor: Turquoise slide. Silver tips. Western.

name: Lab Coat
flavor: White. Pockets full of pens. Makes you feel smart.

name: Judicial Robe
flavor: Black. Voluminous. Commanding.

name: Referee Shirt
flavor: Black and white stripes. Everyone hates you.

name: Clown Shoes
flavor: Size 32. Honk on impact.

name: Rainbow Clown Wig
flavor: Fluffy. Rainbow. Absorbs a surprising amount of blunt force.

name: Button-Up Cardigan
flavor: Pockets full of tissues and hard candy.

name: Zip-Up Hoodie
flavor: Hood up. Hands in the front pocket. Invisible, sort of.

name: Length of Lead Pipe
flavor: Two feet of plumbing that will never carry water again. Carries intent now.

name: Rusty Rebar
flavor: A bent length of rebar with concrete still stuck to one end. Free mace.

name: Two-by-Four
flavor: Pressure-treated lumber. A classic for a reason.

name: Broom Handle
flavor: The broom is gone. The handle remembers everything.

name: Table Leg
flavor: Snapped off a break-room table. Still has a sticky note on it: PLEASE CLEAN UP.

name: Trash Can Lid
flavor: Galvanized steel and old coffee grounds. A shield, technically.

name: Pipe Spear
flavor: A blade taped to a pipe. Reach, finally.

name: Glass Shiv
flavor: A shard of glass with a taped grip. Prison chic.

name: Padlock in a Sock
flavor: A padlock in a tube sock. Every parking-lot fight in history, distilled.

name: Inner-Tube Sling
flavor: An inner tube and a sock. It throws whatever you put in it. Far.

name: Magazine Armor
flavor: Old magazines taped around your torso. The horoscopes are facing out.

name: Strapped Trash-Lid Shield
flavor: A trash can lid with a taped strap. Now it's a shield, emotionally and legally.

name: Club
flavor: The first weapon. Still undefeated.

name: Spiked Club
flavor: A club that went to art school.

name: Mace
flavor: A lump on a stick, for people who find clubs too subtle.

name: Morning Star
flavor: Named by someone who hated mornings.

name: Maul
flavor: For demolition. Of walls, of plans, of whatever's in front of you.

name: Nightstick
flavor: Light, quick, and full of other people's bad decisions.

name: Ball-Peen Hammer
flavor: Small, rude, and fast. Also drives nails.

name: Flail
flavor: A weight on a chain. It hits them. Sometimes it hits you.

name: Golf Club
flavor: A seven iron. Fore is a warning. They never listen.

name: Utility Knife
flavor: The blade clicks out one notch at a time, like a threat.

name: Combat Knife
flavor: Serrated spine, matte finish, the confidence of a mall ninja.

name: Machete
flavor: Clears jungle. Clears hallways. Same motion.

name: Cleaver
flavor: Heavy enough to go through bone, light enough to wave at people.

name: Hatchet
flavor: Camping gear, until it isn't.

name: Shortsword
flavor: An actual sword. The dungeon has a sense of humor about where it leaves these.

name: Falchion
flavor: A sword that wants to be a cleaver when it grows up.

name: Rapier
flavor: Thin, fast, and smug about both.

name: Woodsman's Axe
flavor: Made for trees. Trees don't scream. That's the only difference.

name: Dirk
flavor: Goes between ribs the way gossip goes between friends.

name: Spear
flavor: Keeps the problem at arm's length. A long arm.

name: Garden Fork
flavor: Four tines and a long handle. The mob brought these. You are the mob now.

name: Gaff Hook
flavor: For pulling things closer. Things don't like that.

name: Halberd
flavor: An axe, a spear and a hook, glued together by someone who couldn't choose.

name: Throwing Knives
flavor: A set of six. They always come back, because you go and get them.

name: Throwing Hatchet
flavor: A hatchet with a lot of self-belief.

name: Hunting Bow
flavor: Recurve, mostly. The string is fishing line. It works.

name: Buckler
flavor: A shield the size of a dinner plate. For very small dinners.

name: Riot Shield
flavor: Clear polycarbonate. You can watch it happen.

name: Work Lantern
flavor: Battery-powered. The battery is a lie, but it glows anyway.

name: Site Helmet
flavor: Rated for falling objects. Everything here is a falling object.

name: Leather Cap
flavor: Smells like a bus driver.

name: Skate Helmet
flavor: Foam and optimism. Mostly optimism.

name: Welder's Hood
flavor: You can't see much. Fire can't see much of you.

name: Riot Helmet
flavor: Visor down, chin strap tight, no thoughts.

name: Shop Goggles
flavor: Scratched to a fog. Still safer than nothing, barely.

name: Mirrored Aviators
flavor: They can't tell where you're looking. Neither can you.

name: Night-Vision Goggles
flavor: Everything is green and everything is looking at you.

name: Padded Jacket
flavor: Quilted, like a sad comforter with sleeves.

name: Biker Jacket
flavor: Broken in by someone who died in it. It fits like it remembers.

name: Puffer Vest
flavor: The uniform of men who say 'circle back'. Warm, though.

name: Chain Shirt
flavor: Jingles when you walk. Everything knows you're coming.

name: Riot Vest
flavor: Velcro panels, most of them still there.

name: Scale Hauberk
flavor: Overlapping plates. Like wearing a very angry fish.

name: Cargo Pants
flavor: Fourteen pockets. You'll use two.

name: Hockey Pants
flavor: Padded where it counts and a few places it doesn't.

name: Chain Leggings
flavor: Cold in places you didn't know could get cold.

name: Lace-Up Boots
flavor: Mud in the treads, attitude in the laces.

name: Trail Runners
flavor: Marketed for marathons. Used for fleeing.

name: Gum-Soled Sneakers
flavor: Quiet on tile. Quiet on blood.

name: Rigger Gloves
flavor: The fingers are stiff with something. Grip's good, though.

name: Knuckle-Dusters
flavor: Every swing lands a little heavier with a fist full of metal.

name: Oven Mitts
flavor: You look ridiculous. You are also fireproof up to the wrist.

name: Dog Tags
flavor: Someone else's name. Wear it anyway; it's more than you'll get.

name: Chain Necklace
flavor: Gold-colored. Not gold. Says 'don't' in every language.

name: Backstage Lanyard
flavor: ALL ACCESS. Access to what is unclear.

name: Class Ring
flavor: Class of a year that doesn't exist anymore.

name: Knuckle Ring
flavor: Four fingers' worth of metal. Punches above its weight.

name: Signet Ring
flavor: A family crest. Not your family. Not anyone's, now.

name: Wedding Band
flavor: Inscribed 'forever'. It was right, in a way.

name: Backpack
flavor: Somebody's name is markered inside. You are somebody now.

name: Hiking Pack
flavor: Frame, hip belt, and a little carabiner for your hopes.

name: Bath-Towel Cape
flavor: Safety-pinned at the neck. You've never looked braver or worse.

name: Tool Belt
flavor: Loops for everything. You have nothing for most of them.

name: Utility Belt
flavor: Pouches all the way round. Very prepared, very sad.

name: Weightlifting Belt
flavor: Holds your guts in while you do things guts disagree with.
